description: Counts of how Americans take turns in recorded talk: turn length, short-turn share, question rate, reaction tokens, turn openers and hedges. Counts and one- to three-word tokens only; no line from the corpus ships.

source.document: Santa Barbara Corpus of Spoken American English, Parts 1 to 4
source.publisher: University of California, Santa Barbara, Department of Linguistics

coverage: All 60 recordings, mostly face-to-face conversation among family and friends, with some service encounters, classroom talk and a few monologues; not yet split by setting.

mining.turnRule: A turn is the run of transcript lines by one speaker until another speaker begins.
